resourceProfile.assessment: The complete effective es-419 locale, canonical English scope, glossary, review metadata, and UI context were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata validation, TypeScript typecheck, the full test suite, and the production build passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh pass identified five grouped areas for improvement in the remaining calculator, Wire Wizard, catalog-manager, route-metadata, and comparison wording.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Latin American Spanish human review was performed; the locale remains machine-reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner requested continued improvement, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Several remaining calculator strings used literal, inconsistent, or semantically incorrect Spanish terms.
evidence: Converter, juice, mod-range, and TCR drafts still contained formal register fragments, Aporte, Ahorrar, fuerza for power, and actual for current.
The TCR title omitted de la resistencia and several controls mixed infinitives with formal imperatives.
findings.resolution: Standardized the affected calculator wording, register, electrical terminology, and TCR title and controls.

findings.summary: Wire Wizard still mixed cable, hilo, bobina, and the English product title despite the locale policy preferring alambre and resistencia.
evidence: The effective title and route metadata disagreed between Wire Wizard, Asistente de hilos, and Asistente de cables.
Wire Wizard labels still used cable, Mesa, and other literal or misleading terms in the remaining draft values.
findings.resolution: Standardized the localized title on Asistente de alambres and corrected the remaining alambre, resistencia, vuelta, and current/physical-label wording.

findings.summary: Generic catalog-manager functions produced agreement errors when item names were batteries, materials, or mods.
evidence: Patterns such as `${item} integrados` and `${item} personalizados` could produce mismatched gender and number in Spanish.
The button-top label used a literal noun phrase rather than describing a terminal with a button.
findings.resolution: Rephrased generic messages around elementos to avoid agreement errors and changed the terminal label to Terminal con botón.

findings.summary: Route metadata and the home-page Wire Wizard entry were inconsistent with the calculator terminology policy.
evidence: The route title was still Wire Wizard while the rest of the locale translated the function inconsistently.
The TCR route description referred to a generic temperature coefficient instead of the resistance temperature coefficient.
findings.resolution: Aligned route metadata and home-page presentation with Asistente de alambres and coeficiente de temperatura de la resistencia.

findings.summary: The mods comparer retained a few machine-like or register-inconsistent fallback messages after the first correction batch.
evidence: Fallback messages still used stiff or formal phrasing such as no se registran hallazgos and no se puede comparar completamente.
The comparer draft used Gama de atomizadores while the locale otherwise uses rango for technical ranges.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the fallback messages and standardized the atomizer-range label as Rango del atomizador.
